project_meta.product_name: Franceman Export Desk & Live Support Hub
project_meta.industry: Agricultural Exportation & Global Commodity Trade (Nigeria / International)

tawk_integration.architecture: Hybrid dual-mode: embeddable website widget powered by custom Franceman branded interface synced to live agents in real-time, backed by Tawk.to JavaScript API and Webhooks for omnichannel coverage.

locale_and_culture.default_currency_display: USD ($) for export FOB/CIF quotes; NGN (₦) for domestic farmgate references
locale_and_culture.time_format: 24h West Africa Time (WAT / UTC+1) alongside visitor local time tag

primary_actors.role_context: Corporate commodity trader, food manufacturer, or botanical importer visiting francemann.com from Europe, Asia, or North America on mobile or desktop.
primary_actors.trigger: Looking for pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQ), phytosanitary certificates, sample crates (0.5kg-2kg), or shipping schedules from Apapa/Tin Can ports.
primary_actors.key_decisions: Is Franceman a legitimate NEPC-registered exporter? Can they meet purity and moisture specs? How fast can a sample crate be dispatched via DHL?
primary_actors.desired_outcome: Instant clarification without waiting days; receiving a verified commodity quotation and booking a DHL sample crate.

primary_actors.role_context: Lagos/Asaba export desk operator managing buyer inquiries, quotation requests, and active shipments.
primary_actors.trigger: Incoming chat widget message, automated RFQ prompt, or live buyer browsing high-intent commodity pages (e.g., Ginger or Turmeric FOB specs).
primary_actors.key_decisions: Is the buyer serious? Which commodity cluster and MOQ apply? What CIF incoterms match their destination port?
primary_actors.desired_outcome: Triage buyer inquiry, provide accurate FOB/CIF estimates or sample dispatch terms within minutes, tag high-value trade leads.

primary_actors.role_context: Trade director overseeing export compliance, response SLAs, keyword rules, and agent staffing across global time zones.
primary_actors.trigger: Shift handovers, daily lead conversion reviews, configuring keyword auto-replies (e.g., 'sample', 'FOB', 'phytosanitary'), and managing agent routing.
primary_actors.key_decisions: Are agents responding under the target 3-minute SLA? Are international buyers getting immediate automated responses outside WAT business hours?
primary_actors.desired_outcome: Flawless uptime, automated 24/7 lead capture, accurate export pipeline metrics, and integrated Tawk.to backup.

workload_and_frequency_assumptions.inquiries_per_day: 35-80 active inquiries during peak harvest seasons (Bitter Kola, Ginger harvest cycles) - Assumption
workload_and_frequency_assumptions.team_size: 3 to 6 dedicated export agents + 2 trade directors - Assumption
workload_and_frequency_assumptions.mobile_usage_share: Over 58% of international buyers and 45% of on-the-move export agents interact via mobile browsers - Grounded in trade context and user context

visual_system.direction_rationale: Direction 1: 'Nigerian Botanical Export' was selected over generic modern neutral SaaS. Franceman's brand identity relies on deep Nigerian agricultural heritage, certified rigor (NEPC, ISO 22000, HACCP), and an editorial aesthetic seen on francemann.com with section indicators (§ 01, N°02). The deep forest green conveys agricultural authenticity and stability, while silver, parchment off-white, and warm amber accents reflect premium export standards.

typography.selection_rationale: Geist provides a neutral, crisp, highly legible corporate structure with built-in tabular numbers (tnum), ideal for international export documentation, container sizes (20ft/40ft), lot weights, and precise timestamps without layout shifts.
typography.monospace_usage: Strictly limited to machine artefacts: Tawk.to Site ID ('67e1bc9e4b4636190c495698'), Webhook HMAC tokens, API keys, and raw JSON event logs. Never used for dates, amounts, or phone numbers.

spacing_and_layout.density_standard: Compact to medium: 8px padding on list items, 12px on cards, 16px to 20px on view containers.

navigation_architecture.structure_choice: Vertical Dark Sidebar on Desktop; Sticky Bottom Nav Bar + Slide-over Drawer on Mobile.

evaluated_options: Option A: Top Horizontal Header Bar with dropdown menus
Option B: Vertical Left Collapsible Sidebar with high-contrast Nigerian Forest tone (Chosen)
evaluation_and_tradeoffs.decision_rationale: Option B is vastly superior for Vertical Ops. Support agents monitor live incoming inquiries, status changes, and analytics metrics simultaneously. A vertical sidebar preserves full vertical height for long conversation lists (50+ chats) and allows quick 1-click jumps between Live Visitors, Inbox, Quick Answers, and Analytics without losing filter state.
evaluation_and_tradeoffs.mobile_adaptation: On mobile viewports (≤ 768px), primary workflows collapse into an ergonomic bottom navigation bar with 4 persistent destinations: (1) Inbox [with unread counter pill], (2) Live Visitors, (3) Demo Site / Widget, and (4) Ops / Settings. This satisfies one-thumb operation on smartphones used by export field officers.

rules.response_payload: We supply 500g — 2kg sample crates via DHL Express within 48 hours of confirmation. Every crate includes third-party laboratory Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and botanical origin trace record.
Our export MOQs: Kola Nut (500 kg), Bitter Kola (300 kg), Ginger (1,000 kg / 1 MT), Turmeric (1,000 kg), Hibiscus (1,000 kg), Sesame Seeds (5,000 kg / 5 MT), Raw Cashew Nuts (5,000 kg).
We ship FOB Apapa or Tin Can Island Ports (Lagos), or CIF destination port worldwide. Bills of Lading and phytosanitary documents are released within 24 hours of vessel departure.
Franceman holds active NEPC Export Registration, ISO 22000 Food Safety certification, HACCP Compliance, and issues federal Phytosanitary Certificates for every European, Asian, and American cargo.

features.title: AI Export Commodity Assistant
features.system_instructions: Specialized in Nigerian agricultural export commodities. Strictly adheres to Franceman quality specs, FOB/CIF incoterms, and never quotes binding spot rates without trade broker sign-off.
